_comment: MCP servers for a Hermes profile. Merge into config.yaml under mcp_servers, or keep as a separate file if the deployment loads one. Add servers ONE AT A TIME and test tool selection after each - see README.md for why.

clickup._note: Deletes are removed rather than approval-gated. Nobody has ever needed an agent to delete a ticket, and the failure mode is unrecoverable.

google_drive._note: Read-only. Sharing in particular is a data-leak shaped tool - keep it out.

slack._note: post_message stays approval-gated by the tool-orchestration skill even though it is allowed here. Allowed means the tool exists; the skill decides when it fires.

postgres_readonly._note: Connect with a genuinely read-only database role. Do not rely on the agent choosing not to write - rely on the credential being unable to.
